title: JWT decode call — confirm signature enforcement — review required
description: A jwt.decode() call parses a JSON Web Token. If signature verification is disabled or the algorithm list is attacker-controlled, forged tokens authenticate as anyone. This lexical rule flags every decode call; the reviewer must confirm verification is enforced.
remediation: Always verify: pass an explicit algorithms allowlist, keep verify_signature enabled, and validate issuer, audience, and expiry claims. Never decode-then-trust in a separate step.
limitation: Lexical: flags all jwt.decode( calls including correctly verified ones, because call arguments need human review. Other JWT libraries are out of scope for this rule.
